title: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished custom built Aluminium FUPS Bullbar. #6
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium custom built FUPS Bullbar 381 style channel. 76 mm diameter 6mm wall hi-tensile one piece pipe passing through drilled hi-tensile uprights for maximum protection. No butt welds. Optional 100mm or 88mm pipe can be ordered. Flat bar mounts for driving lights to customer requirements. Heavy duty box uprights shown with outer uprights set flush with main channel. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Indicator lights mounted on centre main cross pipe. Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin, Optional hi-tensile aluminium backing plate available on request giving up to an 80kg saving over the steel backing plate. Provision for front mudflaps. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
